title: link3
tagline: Link3 IOS is a lightweight iOS app that utilises enstate.rs for blazingly fast ENS record display.
description:
This project leverages ensstate.rs, a rust-based library for handling ENS records that is very fast, to display IPFS data and other ENS records. In doing so, an iOS app has been created to interact with ENS and display web3 identities with its own dedicated app.

In future, I would like to see this project displaying the records more beautifully (due to time constraints within the hackathon this has not been possible) and possibly add more ENS implementation.
how_its_made:
SwiftUI (unfortunately). I did not use any sponsor technologies because I wanted to learn  how to make iOS apps.... it's bad....
